description: One top chart as we last measured it: the ranked app ids for a storefront, list kind and optional category, with the day it was read. Pass `estimates: true` for each rank's monthly value (revenue on Top Grossing, downloads on Top Free) and what it takes to enter at #10, #50 and #100. 10 credits for the list; with estimates, 50 more per row returned. App Store only — Google Play has no public top chart, and a number there would be invented.

country.description: storefront code, e.g. us (defaults to us)

estimates.description: true adds each rank's monthly value (50 credits per row)

genre.description: Apple genre id, e.g. 6007; omit for the overall chart

name: market_charts
